newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins unaffected by IMF news.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins unaffected by IMF news.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were little changed in thin early trading on Friday, unaffected by news Russia expects to receive money from the IMF loan soon after May.
Dealers said global trends on U.S. Treasuries and emerging markets dominated the market's moves.

IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus said on Thursday the IMF board was likely to approve the 1997 part of Russia's three-year programme in May and payments of the loan would resume soon afterwards.
"Nothing is happening, at least right now. People could be waiting for foreigners to step in," a Russian bank dealer said.
Dealers said the trend of U.S. Treasury bond markets was more important than the IMF news or other Russian developments.
"News from Russia might affect but not much compared with the impact of (U.S.) Treasuries," one said.
